t: Ribbono shel olam sheomerim bishat nesiat kappayim
s: Ribbono shel olam sheomerim bishat nesiat kappayim ubo b' seipim: mi sheraa chalom veeno yodea ma raa vechoshesh shemma chalam chalom shetztzarik lirpua — yaqum lipne hakkohanim beshaa shennosein kappehen veyomar "ribbono shel olam ani shellak ku' im tzerikim repua repaem ku'". Veyakavven lesayyem keshemmesayyemin hakkohanim pasuq a' o b' o g', kede sheyyaanu hatztzibbur amen gam al baqqashato. Veim lo siyyemu hakkohanim adayin — yosip veyomar: "addir bammarom ku'" ad sheyyesayyemu hakkohanim. Ubemaqom sheen olin laddukan — yomar kol zeh beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur omer "sim shalom". Vikavven lesayyem im hashsheliach tzibbur, sheyyaanu hatztzibbur amen. Veim roeh shello yukal lesayyem im hashsheliach tzibbur — yatchil beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur omer "yebarekka". Velo yomar ken bekol yom vayom, ella beyom sheraa chalom. Umah shennahagu hakkol lomar ken baregel keshehakkohanim olim laddukan, zehu lepi shei epshar shello raa chalom shetztzarik repua ben regel laregel:

Tob lomar techilla "ben chalomot shechalamti al acherim" veachar kak "ben chalomot shechalamti al atzmi veshechalemu acherim alay", lepi sheameru: hammitpallel al chabero — hu naaneh techilla, laken yesh lo lehaqdim tepillato al acherim meal atzmo. Venohagin lesayyem "vetishmereni utechanneni vetirtzeni". "Vetishmereni" — keneged "veyishmereka", "utechanneni" — keneged vichunnekka", "vetirtzeni" — hu ratzon veshalom:
